name: Agamand Mills
summary: Agamand Mills lie in ruin across northern Tirisfal, now the Scourge’s largest stronghold in the region. The wealthy Agamand dynasty once held this farm and milling estate.

sections.title: A House Divided
sections.body: The Agamand family built its estate around a vast milling network across northern Tirisfal. When the Scourge swept across Lordaeron during the Third War, patriarch Gregor Agamand refused to flee. He fortified the compound and persuaded his retainers and laborers to stand with him. Their provisions and stone walls might have held, but their youngest son, Devlin Agamand, betrayed them. Devlin slaughtered the estate watchmen and let the walking dead into the sleeping quarters. Crippled from within, the remaining defenders fell, and the family joined the mindless ranks of the undead.

sections.title: A Bastion of Rot
sections.body: Agamand Mills are the Scourge’s strongest hold in Tirisfal Glades, and a direct threat to the Forsaken realm. Rotting windmills turn above fields crawling with wights, zombies, and skeletal horrors. Beneath the estate, Captain Dargol commands the garrison from the Agamand Family Crypt, where he practices necromancy to reanimate generations of Agamand ancestors. From Brill, Magistrate Sevren and the Deathguards fight to clear the mills and purge the Scourge before it can march on the Undercity.

faq.q: Why is Agamand Mills overrun with Scourge?
aliases: why are there undead at the mills
faq.answer: When the Scourge ravaged Lordaeron, the Agamand family fortified their estate and tried to hold back the undead. Their youngest son, Devlin Agamand, betrayed them and opened the gates to the Scourge. Everyone within was slaughtered and reanimated.

faq.q: Who controls the mills right now?
aliases: who is in charge at the mills
faq.answer: Captain Dargol leads the Scourge at Agamand Mills. Deep in the fortified Agamand Family Crypt, he uses dark magic to raise ancestral corpses as new soldiers.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken care about this place?
faq.answer: Agamand Mills hold the largest concentration of mindless Scourge forces in Tirisfal Glades. If left unchecked, Captain Dargol’s force threatens Brill and could choke off roads south to the Undercity.

The Agamands were a wealthy human family of Lordaeron who owned the mills and surrounding farmland in northern Tirisfal. Their reanimated scions, including Gregor, Nissa, Thurman, and Devlin, now wander the grounds as mindless thralls.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, reclaiming Agamand Mills means vengeance against the Scourge. Former estate servants like Coleman Farthing also have scores to settle.
